tasks.title: Design the frozen toy validation protocol under certificate contract 1.0.0-review

handoff.objective: Design one frozen toy validation protocol under certificate contract 1.0.0-review that pins a concrete public toy fixture, a sealed empty-or-pilot pre-execution schedule template, an independent verifier artifact hash, and the group-operation type vocabulary, or return a decisive scoped no-go at the first obligation that cannot be frozen.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the reviewed frontier-B certificate schema can be instantiated as a single concrete, hash-bound toy protocol eligible for a later (separately approved) executable validation campaign.
inputs: TASK-20260722-014 independent review report and residual objections
constraints: Review-only theory and schema work; do not implement, execute, or run any experiment or solver.
Operate strictly under certificate contract version 1.0.0-review; do not alter the contract schema.

Pin one concrete public toy fixture: a small prime-field curve/group with explicit modulus, subgroup order, factor-base points, canonical point encoding, and fixture_sha256 over the fixture bytes. The verifier must independently reparse and check group/subgroup membership.

Seal an empty-or-pilot pre-execution schedule template: either zero attempts (empty sealed template) or a small pilot set with concrete 256-bit seeds, a finite acyclic retry forest, ordinals contiguous from zero, and a precommit seal binding schedule_sha256, snapshot commit, and verified-before-execution gate. No attempt may be appended after the seal.

Pin an independent verifier identity, version, and artifact_sha256: name the exact independent verifier implementation (or a hash-bound verifier specification artifact) that will recompute relation, row, and incremental rank. The verifier must be independent of the producer solver path.

Freeze an explicit finite group-operation type vocabulary for the group_operations_by_declared_type resource coordinate (e.g., {ADD, DOUBLE, NEGATE, ...} with exact counting conventions); no open-ended or prose-only vocabulary.

Carry forward every conservation, bijection, rank, resource-vector, probability-gate, and planted-control obligation from the certificate contract; the protocol must be a concrete instance of that schema, not a redesign.
Maximum claim tier is toy. Make no attack improvement, ECDLP lower-bound, cryptographic-scale, breakthrough, or universal impossibility claim.
If any obligation cannot be frozen, identify the first exact failed obligation and provide a reader-checkable scoped no-go derivation; do not assert universal impossibility.
Write only within the assigned write scope; preserve all pre-existing paths.

Record requested_policy research-sol-max, the resolved runtime model id, reasoning_effort, fallback_used true, and authorization_ref DEC-20260722-005. Do not claim equivalence between the fallback and the unavailable policy.
completion_gate: Both review-only artifacts exist and bind all relied-upon inputs by hash.

The protocol either freezes every fixture, schedule, verifier, type-vocabulary, field, row, rank, resource, probability, and control field, or identifies the first missing obligation in a scoped no-go derivation.
Exactly one recommended next action is recorded and no implementation or experiment is authorized.
The inference receipt records requested_policy, resolved model, and fallback_used true; otherwise the task is invalid.
handoff.return_format: YAML frozen toy validation protocol plus Markdown design rationale or scoped no-go analysis.

tasks.title: Archive the frozen toy validation protocol snapshot

handoff.objective: Commit exactly the TASK-20260725-001 frozen toy validation protocol artifacts as an isolated Coordinator snapshot before any independent review reads them.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the reviewer receives an immutable, hash-bound protocol package whose bytes cannot change after the snapshot seal.
constraints: Run alone; stage only the declared producer artifact paths and the snapshot receipt; preserve every unrelated dirty file.
Record commit_sha, parent_sha, and SHA-256 for every committed path in the receipt after the commit; do not put a commit's own SHA inside that commit.
Verify the producer inference receipt records the authorized fallback metadata before archival.
Stop on any integrity failure; a failed snapshot gate is an evidence-integrity failure, not a negative result.
completion_gate: The post-commit verifier accepts exact paths, parent, message IDs, reachability from HEAD, and SHA-256 values.

tasks.title: Independently review the frozen toy validation protocol

handoff.objective: Independently falsify the frozen toy validation protocol's fixture validity, schedule seal completeness, verifier pin concreteness, group-operation type vocabulary exhaustiveness, certificate-contract 1.0.0-review conformance, and claim boundaries.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the protocol is concrete and contract-conformant enough to govern a later (separately approved) toy executable validation campaign.
inputs: verified TASK-20260725-002 snapshot of the TASK-20260725-001 protocol
EV-ECDLP-004, DEC-20260722-005, and the TASK-20260722-014 review report
constraints: Use a non-originating independent review session; the reviewer must not have produced any TASK-20260725-001 artifact.
Validate the snapshot receipt (ancestry, parent, exact paths, SHA-256) before interpreting the protocol.
Independently reparse and check the pinned public fixture: primality, subgroup order, point membership, and fixture_sha256 over the declared bytes.
Challenge the sealed schedule template: ordinals, seeds, retry-forest acyclicity, precommit seal binding, and the no-append-after-seal rule.
Verify the independent verifier identity/version/artifact_sha256 is concrete and independent of the producer solver path.
Verify the group-operation type vocabulary is finite, explicit, and has exact counting conventions (not prose-only).
Check every conservation, bijection, rank, resource-vector, probability-gate, and planted-control obligation is carried forward as a concrete instance of certificate contract 1.0.0-review.
Treat a scoped no-go derivation as a reviewable proposal result, not a universal lower bound.
Authorize no implementation, experiment, attack claim, or cryptographic inference. Maximum claim tier is toy.
Record requested_policy review-xhigh, the resolved runtime model id, fallback_used true, and that equivalence to review-xhigh is not claimed.
completion_gate: Both reports bind the verified snapshot and reviewed inputs.
The report returns PASS, REVISE, or FAIL with exact non-breakthrough boundaries.
The review records an independent non-originating session and exactly one recommended action.
The runtime receipt records requested_policy, resolved model, and fallback_used true; equivalence to review-xhigh is not claimed.
handoff.return_format: Independent YAML verdict plus Markdown adversarial reconstruction.
